headline: Jailer 2 is expected to reach 23.6K tickets today, with 24.9K expected tomorrow on Friday.
bullets: Jailer 2 has 17.3K tickets so far today, and the full day is expected at 23.6K (range 22.6K to 24.7K), down 21% vs yesterday.
The busiest hour still ahead is 9–10 PM at about 1.6K (range 1.3K to 1.8K), with 8–9 PM near 1.5K and 10–11 PM near 1.3K.
Tomorrow, Fri 6 Nov, is expected at 24.9K (range 21.5K to 34K), since Friday is usually a stronger day with new releases opening.
The film is 21 days past release, and no review or word-of-mouth signals are included because that information is only collected for films switched on, so the forecast rests on usual patterns.
watch: Diwali on 8 Nov is a listed holiday that could shift demand, so later days are less certain.
Tomorrow's range is wide (21.5K to 34K); next-hour estimates are typically within x0.88 to x1.12, so recheck as hours pass.
